rangeMap.note: Adult bluish-grey head/upperparts, yellow orbital ring, white underparts with extensive diffuse greyish-pink streaks; usually white tertial patch, broad dark subterminal tail bar with mostly rufous tip, narrow grey bar above. LC globally decreasing, HK increased not global trend. Breeds Nepal/east Himalayas/Myanmar/parts Indochina/S China, winters Sumatra/Java/Borneo.
